items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: Bob Summers was another trumpet player. We were the four white guys.

ctx.x: No. There was no racial fighting at all. Four white guys. I was one of them. Eric Schneider was a tenor player from Chicago, Dale Carley was playing lead trumpet at the time, he’s from Silver Springs, Maryland, and Bob Summers was another trumpet player. We were the four white guys. There was never a black and white issue on the band, which made it so relaxed you know. Because there could have been very easily. You never know. Guys like Miles, he didn’t hide his racial preference. He told everybody, you know,…
When you first got on the Basie bus, was there a question like where do I go?
